title: Check the type of several values
description: Write a function `type_names(values)` that returns a list of the type name of each value in `values`, using `type()`.
hints: type(value).__name__ gives the type's plain name as a string ('str', 'int', ...) rather than the full repr like <class 'str'>.
Build a list comprehension over values that computes type(v).__name__ for each v.
expected_behavior: Returns the type name of each value, in order.
solution:
def type_names(values):
    return [type(v).__name__ for v in values]
explanation: type(v) returns the type object itself; .__name__ reads off just its plain-text name, which is what's actually useful to compare or print.
